ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first AI advisory agent built for farmers in Bihar to make instant decisions on crop selection and irrigation using Gemini.
ideas.problem_statement: Theme: AgriTech Bihar: Empowering Farmers Through Technology - Helping farmers make decisions on what to sow, when to irrigate, who to sell to, and at what price.
ideas.title: BiharKisan Voice-First Advisory
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on the localized AgriTech Bihar theme and leverages Gemini AI for quick deployment, matching patterns from successful multilingual rural AI tools.

ideas.pitch: A real-time AI pricing and market matching app helping local farmers find the best mandi prices across Bihar districts.
ideas.problem_statement: Theme: AgriTech Bihar: Empowering Farmers Through Technology - Every season, a farmer in Bihar makes hundreds of decisions with incomplete information regarding pricing and selling.
ideas.title: MandiPrice Predictor Bihar
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets direct economic impact for farmers with quantified metrics, directly addressing the core pain point of incomplete market information.

ideas.pitch: An AI crop disease detector that works via text descriptions or image classification and outputs actionable advice via offline SMS simulation.
ideas.problem_statement: Theme: AgriTech Bihar: Empowering Farmers Through Technology - Empowering farmers through technology with low-connectivity considerations.
ideas.title: FasalCheck Offline SMS Agronomist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines image classification with practical local delivery mechanisms, echoing past winning AgriTech designs.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered soil health remediation planner that analyzes soil test reports and recommends precise fertilizer usage for Bihar's agro-climatic zones.
ideas.problem_statement: Theme: AgriTech Bihar: Empowering Farmers Through Technology - Helping farmers make informed input decisions like irrigation and soil management.
ideas.title: Bihar Soil Doctor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides concrete, measurable agronomic recommendations that directly reduce input costs and increase crop yield.

ideas.pitch: A single-interface multi-modal assistant for Bihar farmers to upload leaf photos, check weather conditions, and get voice answers in local dialects.
ideas.problem_statement: Theme: AgriTech Bihar: Empowering Farmers Through Technology - Empowering farmers through technology with multi-faceted decision support.
ideas.title: KisanSahayak Multi-Modal Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes multimodal capabilities of Google's AI models to provide an all-in-one companion app executable within a tight 3-hour window.
